description: The field contract for ONE inheritance manifest. A load-bearing mechanism declares, before it may hold authority, exactly which shared semantics it consumes and at which version, plus only its genuine subject-specific extensions. bin/fm-semantics.sh manifest is its only interpreter.
why: A mechanism may not silently define another local meaning for a shared concept. Without a manifest, the seventh mechanism reinvents the law a seventh time and nobody finds out until two owners disagree at a boundary. With one, the reuse is declared, the divergence is visible in a diff, and a new distinction has to be argued rather than assumed.
authority_why: New on this branch. A manifest is REQUIRED before authority; it does not itself confer any, and the CI check that enforces its presence is enabled only for mechanisms that declare themselves load-bearing in semantics/census.json.

required.id: stable slug, unique across semantics/manifests/, matching the file basename
required.mechanism: one sentence: what this mechanism is
required.owner: the single file or component that owns the mechanism
required.load_bearing: true or false - whether any decision, gate, effect or captain-facing sentence depends on this mechanism state
required.authority_status: one of authoritative or diagnostic - what this mechanism output may currently be used for
required.extensions: array, possibly empty, of genuine subject-specific extensions
required.gate_rules: array of gate-placement predicate ids from semantics/laws.json that apply to this mechanism

consumes_fields.state_families: version consumed from semantics/state-families.json family_vocabulary_version, or the literal none with a stated reason
consumes_fields.transitions: version consumed from transition_version, or none with a reason
consumes_fields.terminal_reasons: version consumed from terminal_vocabulary_version, or none with a reason
consumes_fields.reason_namespaces: array of declared namespace names from semantics/reasons.json this mechanism emits reasons in, plus the reason_register_version
consumes_fields.identity_namespaces: array of declared namespace ids from semantics/identity.json this mechanism resolves within, plus the namespace_register_version
consumes_fields.canonical_subject: the subject_schema_version consumed, and the subject_type this mechanism subjects are, or none with a reason
consumes_fields.evidence_and_cno: which verdict vocabulary this mechanism returns - observation or validator - and its owner
consumes_fields.effects: whether this mechanism performs an effect on the outside world, and if so which of the four lifecycle points it implements
consumes_fields.authority: whether this mechanism requires a spendable authority, and which object family member vocabulary it reads
consumes_fields.seam_protocol: array of declared protocol ids from semantics/seams.json this mechanism produces or consumes, with which side it is on
consumes_fields.compatibility_adapters: array of adapters this mechanism relies on, each naming from_version, to_version and retirement condition; empty when none
consumes_fields.freshness: which axes this mechanism treats as mutable, and where it re-observes them
consumes_fields.gate_rules: handled at the top level, not repeated here

none_is_a_declaration_not_an_omission: A consumes field may be the literal none, and when it is, it must carry a reason. That keeps two different facts apart: this mechanism has no states, and nobody filled this in. An absent key is refused; an explicit none with a reason is accepted and is visible in review.

extension_fields.extends: which canonical concept this extends - one of state_family, terminal_reason, reason_namespace, identity_namespace, subject_type, protocol, or seam
extension_fields.name: the local name being introduced
extension_fields.consumer_action_distinction: REQUIRED. One sentence naming a consumer whose ACTION differs because of this distinction. Aesthetics, symmetry, and it feels different are not admissible.
extension_fields.why_canonical_reuse_fails: REQUIRED. Which canonical member was considered and what it cannot express.
extension_fields.proposed_canonical_extension: optional. If the distinction is general, the change that would move it into the canonical owner instead.

extension_rule: A new distinction requires a stated consumer-action difference AND an attempt to extend the shared contract first. A member that no consumer branches on is a SYNONYM, and synonyms are how a vocabulary becomes unusable. An extension whose name collides with a canonical member is refused outright rather than shadowing it, because a local redefinition of a shared word is the exact failure this manifest exists to prevent.
refused_keys_why: The first nine are refused for the reason commitments/schema.json already refuses them: a hand-written status word must not be able to stand in for an observation, and an ignored field still reads to a human as the answer. The last three are refused because a manifest that carries a task, a queue or a schedule has started to be a runtime, and this register may describe semantics only.
invariants: id_matches_basename: the manifest id must equal its file basename without the extension
consumes_complete: every field in consumes_fields must be present, as a version or as an explicit none with a reason
consumed_versions_current: every declared version must equal the version the corresponding owner document currently declares, so a manifest cannot claim to inherit a vocabulary it has not seen
reason_namespaces_declared: every named reason namespace must exist in semantics/reasons.json
identity_namespaces_declared: every named identity namespace id must exist in semantics/identity.json
protocols_declared: every named protocol must exist in semantics/seams.json
gate_rules_declared: every named gate rule must exist in semantics/laws.json gate_placement
extension_requires_rationale: every extension must carry a non-empty consumer_action_distinction AND why_canonical_reuse_fails
extension_may_not_shadow: an extension name may not equal any canonical member of the concept it extends
no_refused_keys: a manifest carrying any refused key is refused outright rather than having the key ignored
